artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K>1$. Recall that a generalized arithmetic progression (GAP) of rank $r$ in $\mathbb{Z}$ is a set of the form
$$P=\{a_0+n_1 a_1+\cdots+n_r a_r : 0\le n_i< N_i\},$$
with $a_0,a_1,\dots,a_r\in\mathbb{Z}$ and positive integers $N_1,\dots,N_r$; its size is $|P|\le N_1\cdots N_r$.

Prove or disprove: there exists a constant $C=C(K)>0$ such that for every pair of finite, non-empty sets $A,B\subset\mathbb{Z}$ satisfying
$$|A+B|<K|A|\qquad\text{and}\qquad |B|\le |A|,$$
there exist a generalized arithmetic progression $P\subset\mathbb{Z}$ of rank at most $C$ and a set $X\subset\mathbb{Z}$ such that
$$B\subset P,\qquad A\subset X+P,\qquad |X+P|<C|A|.$$

(The case $|A|=|B|$ reduces, via Ruzsa's covering lemma, to Freiman's theorem; the case where $|A|$ and $|B|$ are of comparable order follows easily. Using Plünnecke's inequalities one can obtain a weaker version in which the requirement that $P$ be a GAP of bounded rank is replaced by a doubling-type bound $|P+P|\le c(K,\varepsilon)|A|^{\varepsilon}|P|$.)
artifact.status_search_result: A direct search did not turn up a paper resolving this asymmetric Freiman-type question for distinct integer summands $A,B$ with $|B|\le|A|$ and $|A+B|<K|A|$ in the form of a GAP of bounded rank covering $B$ together with a small cover $X+P$ of $A$. Standard references (Plünnecke–Ruzsa, Ruzsa's covering lemma, Green–Ruzsa for abelian groups) provide weaker conclusions or handle the symmetric/comparable-size case, but a definitive resolution of the stated question could not be confirmed.

status_evidence.title: Freiman's theorem - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Freiman's theorem describes the structure of a finite set A of integers with small doubling |A+A| <= K|A|, contained in a generalized arithmetic progression of bounded rank.
status_evidence.claim: Classical Freiman's theorem covers the symmetric case A=B; the asymmetric distinct-summand version with |B|<=|A| is not stated.

status_evidence.title: Structure Theory of Set Addition - B. J. Green
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys Freiman-type theorems, Plünnecke inequalities, and Ruzsa's covering lemma; weaker asymmetric statements are obtained via Plünnecke's inequalities.
status_evidence.claim: Standard surveys give only the weaker Plünnecke-type asymmetric conclusion mentioned in the problem.
